name: DatenkranzRareDisease
title: genomDE KDK Rare Disease Datenkranz (logical model)
description: Logical model of the BfArM MV-GenomSeq KDK rare-disease submission (schemas/kdk/RareDiseases.json), generated by scripts/schema_to_logical.py; the source type of the genomDE FML StructureMaps. Element names are the JSON property names, so a raw Datenkranz JSON instance parses against it unchanged. Dates are kept as strings (copied verbatim), enumerations are strings whose allowed values are listed in each element definition.

element.short: genomDE KDK Rare Disease Datenkranz (logical model)
element.definition: Logical model of the BfArM MV-GenomSeq KDK rare-disease submission (schemas/kdk/RareDiseases.json), generated by scripts/schema_to_logical.py; the source type of the genomDE FML StructureMaps. Element names are the JSON property names, so a raw Datenkranz JSON instance parses against it unchanged. Dates are kept as strings (copied verbatim), enumerations are strings whose allowed values are listed in each element definition.
(no description in the BfArM schema)
(no description in the BfArM schema)

element.short: Date of submission in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD
element.definition: Date of submission in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD Schema facets: format="date".

element.short: The options are: 'initial' for first submission, 'followup' is for followup submissions, 'addition' for additional su...
element.definition: The options are: 'initial' for first submission, 'followup' is for followup submissions, 'addition' for additional submission, 'correction' for correction, 'test' is for technical testing of submissions Allowed values: 'initial', 'followup', 'addition', 'correction', 'test'.

element.short: LE ID as specified by the BfArM or RVO
element.definition: LE ID as specified by the BfArM or RVO

element.short: Id of the genomic data center, format GRZXXXnnn 9-digit assigned by BfArM
element.definition: Id of the genomic data center, format GRZXXXnnn 9-digit assigned by BfArM. Not required in cases where diagnosisOd.libraryType = none.

element.short: Id of the clinical data node, format KDKXXXnnn 9-digit assigned by BfArM
element.definition: Id of the clinical data node, format KDKXXXnnn 9-digit assigned by BfArM

element.short: Type of disease (must be oncological or hereditary for Oncology object, rare for RareDiseasesObject)
element.definition: Type of disease (must be oncological or hereditary for Oncology object, rare for RareDiseasesObject) Allowed values: 'oncological', 'rare', 'hereditary'.
(no description in the BfArM schema)

element.short: Date of delivery
element.definition: Date of delivery. Date (in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD) on which the Model Project Declaration of Participation was presented to the patient, unless identical to the date of signature Schema facets: format="date".

element.short: Version of the declaration of participation
element.definition: Version of the declaration of participation. Name and version of the declaration of participation in the MV GenomSeq, e.g.: 'Patient Info TE Consent MVGenomSeq vers01'

element.short: Modules of the consent to MV: must have at least a permit of mvSequencing
element.definition: Modules of the consent to MV: must have at least a permit of mvSequencing

element.short: Consent or refusal to participate and consent, must be indicated for each option listed in the scope of consent.
element.definition: Consent or refusal to participate and consent, must be indicated for each option listed in the scope of consent. Allowed values: 'permit', 'deny'.

element.short: Date of signature of the pilot projects consent; in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD.
element.definition: Date of signature of the pilot projects consent; in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD. Schema facets: format="date".

element.short: Scope of consent or revocation.
element.definition: Scope of consent or revocation. Allowed values: 'mvSequencing', 'reIdentification', 'caseIdentification'.

element.short: Research consents
element.definition: Research consents. Multiple declarations of consent are possible! Must be assigned to the respective data sets. Schema alternatives/conditions: oneOf: (requires scope) | (requires noScopeJustification).

element.short: Schema version of de.medizininformatikinitiative.kerndatensatz.consent
element.definition: Schema version of de.medizininformatikinitiative.kerndatensatz.consent Allowed values: '2025.0.1'.

element.short: Date of the delivery of the research consent in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
element.definition: Date of the delivery of the research consent in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) Schema facets: format="date".
